users.shared_pool_description: A site-wide pool that covers spending when a user's own balance runs out. Anyone can donate credits from their profile; users with transfer permission can grant pool credits from a user's edit page.

ip_access.description: One IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR range per line, up to 100 entries. Blank allows any IP. Accounts with multiple restricted roles must match every list.
ip_access.exemption: Allow this account from any IP address, overriding all role IP restrictions.
